dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, linear narrowing from the widest mid-lateral point toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a slight localized bulge on the mid-left side and a shallow indentation on the mid-right side.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-frequency light-grey shading along the lower dorsal flank.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low; presence of diffuse, low-contrast grey patches concentrated primarily in the posterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradient transitions between the primary white canvas and the darker posterior shading.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, small circular dark mark in the mid-dorsal region and a thin horizontal dark line further down the posterior axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A circular topological depression is visible in the mid-dorsal area, casting a faint shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent circular scar/indentation located centrally on the mid-back and a transverse linear mark on the lower back area.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, dark elliptical blowhole visible at the anterior-most dorsal point.
